ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central black field extending from the fluke base; expansive white lobes featuring diffuse yellowish-tan mottling in the medial sections; dark pigmentation bordering the entire trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch at the central axis, displaying sharp convergence at the apex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with moderate frequency; highest amplitude peaks located on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips, which terminate in sharp, upward-turned points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark, high-contrast irregular clusters consistent with barnacle colonization situated on the extreme tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical black linear streaks (rake marks) observed on the right lobe near the transition from white to black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Biological encrustations attached to the distal tips of both lobes; dark vertical linear scarring on the inner right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse yellowish/ochre pigmentation patches located centrally on both fluke lobes.
